```artifact
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import Prescription, Chemist, Lab, Admin, Patient

class TestPrescriptionFlow(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_prescription_received_by_patient(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        
        # Act
        patient.receive_prescription(prescription)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.patient, patient)
        
    def test_prescription_received_by_nearest_local_chemist(self):
        # Arrange
        chemist = Chemist("Local Chemist", "123 Main St")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        
        # Act
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.chemist, chemist)
        
    def test_prescription_received_by_nearest_local_lab(self):
        # Arrange
        lab = Lab("Local Lab", "456 Elm St")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        
        # Act
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.lab, lab)
        
    def test_chemist_provides_medicines_via_offline_delivery(self):
        # Arrange
        chemist = Chemist("Local Chemist", "123 Main St")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        
        # Act
        chemist.deliver_medicines(prescription)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(prescription.delivered)
        
    def test_lab_collects_specimen_and_delivers_lab_reports(self):
        # Arrange
        lab = Lab("Local Lab", "456 Elm St")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        
        # Act
        lab.collect_specimen(prescription)
        lab.deliver_lab_reports(prescription)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(prescription.lab_report_delivered)
        
    def test_admin_populates_speciality_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin("Admin User", "admin@example.com")
        specialities = ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Oncology"]
        
        # Act
        admin.populate_speciality_database(specialities)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.speciality_database, specialities)
        
    def test_admin_links_specialities_to_doctors(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin("Admin User", "admin@example.com")
        specialities = ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Oncology"]
        doctors = ["Dr. Smith", "Dr. Johnson", "Dr. Williams"]
        
        # Act
        admin.link_specialities_to_doctors(specialities, doctors)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctor_database, {speciality: [doctor] for speciality, doctor in zip(specialities, doctors)})
        
    def test_admin_populates_lab_and_chemist_databases(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin("Admin User", "admin@example.com")
        labs = ["Local Lab", "Regional Lab"]
        chemists = ["Local Chemist", "Regional Chemist"]
        
        # Act
        admin.populate_lab_and_chemist_databases(labs, chemists)
        
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.lab_database, labs)
        self.assertEqual(admin.chemist_database, chemists)
        
    def test_patient_registers_into_system(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")
        
        # Act
        patient.register()
        
        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(patient.registered)
```
